APPROVE
`Lex` is now a plain loop that hands work to helpers, so its cognitive complexity is about 8. Each helper does exactly what the original did: comment blanking, the `$`/`@` prefix scan, raw and verbatim literal handling, and the escape and newline termination rules. Everything compiles as static members of the static class. One caveat: the repository wasn't available, so I reviewed only the diff and couldn't confirm that the new helper names don't clash with existing members elsewhere in the partial class.
